name: The Thailand Full Moon Spell
hook: Island days. Moonlit nights. A little further from ordinary.
imageNote: Moon, Krabi and Samui artwork is AI-generated for atmosphere; it does not depict confirmed hotels or the booked event.
about:
Six days from Krabi's island waters to the palm-lined shores of Koh Samui, with Koh Phangan's Full Moon Party at the heart of the journey. Arrive through Phuket, settle into Krabi, cross to Samui and return to Phuket for one last day before flying home.

23-28 September 2026 · 6 days / 5 nights · 10 adults / 5 rooms.

Price TBA. The Full Moon Party ticket is at your own cost. Hotels listed are proposed properties or similar; final arrangements will be confirmed before travel.
